column1: # SIC code -> sector (approximately GICS; each sector maps to one SPDR sector ETF).

# broad ranges they carve out of. An empty sector means "no sector". Every code 0-9999 is
# covered (tests/unit/test_sectors.py). Lines starting with # are comments.
# No sector: not a SIC code
# Lumber and wood (24): mobile homes and prefabricated buildings are homebuilding
# Furniture (25): household furniture vs office furniture and fixtures
# Printing and publishing (27): publishers vs commercial printers
# Petroleum refining (29): asphalt paving and roofing materials
# Rubber and plastics (30): tires and footwear
# Primary metals (33): nonferrous and optical-fiber wire makers are mostly technology
# Fabricated metal (34): metal cans and drums are packaging
